summary_claims.claim: This consortium is a core element of the new NIST-led U.S. AI Safety Institute announced yesterday at the U.K.’s AI Safety Summit 2023, in which U.S. Secretary of Commerce Gina Raimondo participated.
The institute and its consortium are part of NIST’s response to the recently released Executive Order on Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and Use of AI.
The institute aims to measurably improve organizations’ ability to evaluate and validate AI systems, as detailed in the AI RMF Roadmap.
